entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Pierce (ankle) was present for Tuesday's practice and took part in individual work off to the side under the supervision of a trainer, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley suggested Friday that Bell (knee) might have a chance to play this preseason, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: George Kittle
entries.summary: Kittle (Achilles) was seen running routes, catching passes and doing conditioning work prior to Monday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: The Bills placed Shavers (knee) on the active/PUP list Tuesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: The Seahawks have placed Charbonnet (knee) on the physically unable to perform list ahead of training camp, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (calf) remained sidelined at Saturday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Darren Waller
entries.summary: The Panthers signed Waller (groin) to a one-year contract Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (hamstring) participated in 11-on-11 team drills during Saturday's training camp practice, Noah Furtado of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Jake Bobo
entries.summary: Bobo (hamstring) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Corbin K. Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Conner (foot) isn't yet doing full-team drills at training camp, Darren Urban of azcardinals.com reports.

entries.name: John Bates
entries.summary: Bates will miss "a couple of weeks" due to a hamstring injury, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.

entries.name: Kaelon Black
entries.summary: Black is missing Monday's practice due to an adductor injury, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion said Friday that his shoulder has felt fine since returning to practice earlier this week, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

entries.name: Makai Lemon
entries.summary: Lemon (hamstring) won't take part in Thursday's practice, Eliot Shorr-Parks of Sports Radio 94 WIP Philadelphia reports.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday that Nabers (knee) may mix into team drills as early as next week, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Penix (knee) still hasn't been cleared for 11-on-11s and won't be available for Friday's preseason opener against Denver, Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (quadriceps) is in pads and taking part in warmups ahead of Tuesday's joint practice with the Titans, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Patrick Mahomes
entries.summary: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Friday that Mahomes (knee) is unlikely to play in the Chiefs' preseason opener against the Rams on Saturday, Aug. 15, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Sione Vaki
entries.summary: Vaki suffered a broken nose in Monday's practice, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell (knee) participated in "full-team drills" Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tucker Kraft
entries.summary: Kraft (knee) ran routes on air in full pads while catching passes from QB Jordan Love at Monday's practice, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Xavier Worthy
entries.summary: Worthy (shoulder) will take part in Monday's practice, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Chris Collier
entries.summary: Collier (undisclosed) reverted to injured reserve with the Raiders on Sunday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: John Michael Gyllenborg
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Gyllenborg (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Ricky Pearsall
entries.summary: Pearsall announced Thursday in a post on his personal Instagram account that he underwent season-ending surgery to repair the PCL in his right knee, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.
